rule: A number a matches the expected number b when |a - b| <= rel * max(1, |b|), with rel = rel_special when the path of b is listed in special and rel = rel_default otherwise. A path names a value from the root of the expected JSON: object keys joined by '.', every list index written '[*]' (for example images[*].chains[*].metrics.mvl_ci[*]). Object keys, list lengths, strings, booleans and nulls must be equal.
